title: Virtual Compute: amendment
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — The contract status is active or suspended. The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. The customer files a signed amendment request before the agent applies the approved attributes. The request external reference identifies the signed amendment; its related approved review carries the affected exact values and effective service interval start. Request and review events preserve those effective attributes. Keep status unchanged, use the new tier only for service intervals beginning at the request effective time, and retain old tier and effective price on earlier meter and invoice records. Refuse any change above maximum resource count or when the completed amendment count for the current UTC month has reached monthly amendment limit. Completed amendment requests count once; pending, rejected or cancelled requests do not change the holding. Signed commitments keep their recorded expiration and remaining contractual liability unless the signed amendment explicitly replaces them.

## Evidence — contract state

For amend, The contract status is active or suspended. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using compute contract reference, status. Those records correlate to the current action by compute contract reference.

## Evidence — amendment approved

For amend, The source amendment request is approved and customer-authorized. Before this action, authoritative system records establish the condition using evidence event reference, status, customer request reference, source subtype. Those records correlate to the current action by evidence event reference, customer request reference.

## Recorded accounting basis

UTC calendar month containing the frozen handling time. Count completed request events of source subtype amendment for this holding; cancelled and rejected requests do not count.
